answer: Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch challenge whose seed derives from the prior beacon value. To register, an agent submits a whisper of its secret share to three randomly assigned peers, who co-sign only if the share matches the beacon-derived lotus puzzle solution. Faking an identity means buying a fresh bond, redoing the puzzle, and recruiting three colluding peers, so each sybil costs real stake plus coordination overhead that scales linearly.
